plugin_limit.counts: enabled plugins, including stopped plugins and UI-only tools
plugin_limit.lowering: Rejected below the enabled count; existing plugins remain enabled
plugin_limit.independent_limits: Does not change per-VM quotas, world plates or the single automation driver

host.plugin_snapshot: plugins[id] = {enabled,running}; include plugins in selective snapshot_fields; no configured limit or private peer state
host.platform_notes: Shared Lua API and native UI; individual native services may have narrower platform support

parameters.rule: one validated native loot rule, not a profile or rule array
parameters.item: one host item snapshot with identified and property maps
parameters.snapshot: current callback snapshot; imported character conditions use level, skills and main_pack_slots
parameters.scan: required mutable table; start empty and retain only while this rule/item returns pending

lootmatch.side_effects: Updates scan only; no appraisal, inventory action or chat output
lootmatch.cursor_invalidation: Reset after a completed result or changes to rule, item, appraisal/inventory revision, or referenced character data

spellindex.signature: spellindex(spells, inventory, time, skill_margin, unavailable_until, components_required)
spellindex.components_required_usage: Pass snapshot.components_required ~= false; only explicit false bypasses components
spellindex.unavailable_until: numeric spell ID keys with monotonic retry times
spellindex.supplied: booleans keyed by numeric spell ID

string.findplain.returns: one-based byte position or nil; one return value

regextest.syntax: Bounded ICU/.NET subset: named captures, unnamed-first numeric backreferences, lookbehind, comments, scoped/global x and n options, capture/assertion conditionals and balancing groups. Pattern/input cache keys and capture names are case-sensitive.
regextest.errors: Unsupported pattern or exceeded quota raises a script error

regexmatch.returns: capture object with case-sensitive numeric/name string keys, or nil; key 0 is the whole match; each group is its latest unbalanced capture
regexmatch.syntax: Bounded ICU/.NET subset: named captures, unnamed-first numeric backreferences, lookbehind, comments, scoped/global x and n options, capture/assertion conditionals and balancing groups. Pattern/input cache keys and capture names are case-sensitive.
regexmatch.errors: Unsupported pattern or exceeded quota raises a script error

ucmcommand.returns: compiled policy command record; does not execute it
ucmcommand.errors: Unsupported commands raise a script error

workavailable.returns: boolean; return from callback when false and resume later

chat_subscriptions.rules: same matching predicates as chat_filters; native filtered delivery

command.result: command queued; server response arrives in chat

content.server_authority: ACE enforces developer/admin access; imports read the server content_folder

target_snapshot.selection: Selected object details, or null; no assessment requests are generated
target_snapshot.tracked_targets: Object details keyed by decimal GUID string: selection, active plate targets, and objects with active confirmed timers
target_snapshot.target_effects: Arrays keyed by decimal GUID string: spell, icon, remaining, duration, source=own_confirmed_cast
target_snapshot.unknown_fields: Omitted, including raw weenie_type unless assessment property 9007 was received
target_snapshot.vitals: health/stamina/mana objects with current/max, or health fraction/max after a newer percent-only update

world_plates.opacity: Numbers in [0,1]. opacity controls the whole composed plate; background_opacity multiplies backing alpha. Both default to 1 (opaque). Optional vr_opacity and vr_background_opacity override desktop values. Mesh selection tint is unaffected; unused canvas stays transparent.
world_plates.colors: green/red/yellow/blue/white/purple/black/transparent or #RRGGBB/#RRGGBBAA (sRGB RGB, linear alpha). color: name/brackets; text_color: role/level/numbers/timers; background_color: backing; health_color/stamina_color/mana_color: bar fills. Omission preserves existing colors.
world_plates.transforms: scale 0.25..4 (default 1), offset_x/offset_y -2048..2048 (default 0). Plate-local logical pixels, right/down positive, multiplied by scale; whole plate including brackets moves. vr_scale/vr_offset_x/vr_offset_y override individually, otherwise inherit desktop.
world_plates.refresh: Background assessments share one request per second globally, alternate seconds with running automation; no QueryHealth selection changes. Unknown or denied fields remain absent.
world_plates.effects: spell (optional), icon (0x06xxxxxx DAT ID), remaining (0..86400 seconds)
world_plates.lifecycle: Omission retains; empty array clears; stop, disable, logout, reload and GUID removal clear
world_plates.rendering: Native actor attachment every frame, including stereo VR; no collision or input capture

terrain_overlay.lifecycle: Omission retains; empty object clears; stop, disable, logout, portal transitions and world changes release effects
terrain_overlay.source: Loaded DAT terrain and native retail slope, water and radar rules. No new terrain loads or collision scans. Local visual aid only.

ui_layout.text_scale: Native labels, buttons and editable text respect the player's Lua Plugin Text Scale, independently of chat scale; use flexible layouts
ui_layout.width_height: optional fixed logical dimensions 0..2048; image aspect ratio is preserved
ui_layout.transforms: scale 0.25..4 (default 1), offset_x/offset_y -2048..2048 (default 0). Render scale/rotation about center, then parent logical-pixel offsets right/down. Transforms children and hit targets; does not reserve layout space or resize window.
ui_layout.color_picker: type=color, required value named color or #RRGGBB/#RRGGBBAA; expandable wheel, brightness/opacity sliders and hex input; expanded defaults false. change events return uppercase #RRGGBBAA; author persists state.
ui_layout.align: text justification: left, center or right
ui_layout.progress_colors: color sets bar fill; text_color sets overlaid label, light by default
ui_layout.hide_when_pinned: boolean, native immediate visibility using window_chrome_hidden (includes Quick-show)
ui_layout.clickable: boolean on graphics, frames and gauges; emits a normal click event
ui_layout.effects: opacity/min_opacity 0..1, rotation -360..360, effect blink/pulse/rotate, period 0.1..60 seconds; native frame animation
ui_layout.outline_glow: outline/glow 0..8; outline_color/glow_color; image glow is a simple tinted halo
ui_layout.compact: boolean on rows; all children use natural width; default false
ui_layout.auto_width: boolean on row children; natural width instead of equal fill; default false
ui_layout.wrap: boolean for control labels; false clips to one line; default true
ui_layout.panel_snapshot: panel.width/height: last measured available logical UI size for scroll=false panels; absent before first layout

cast_item.constraints: Equipped owned casting implement. Eligible innate instant self recovery targets player; harmful timed debuffs require a living attackable non-player/non-pet and clear projectile sight. Uses item mana/activation, not learned spell components. Completion is a use receipt; verify vital/debuff separately. Optional motion flags require navigation and default false.

select_item.rules: API 2 companions and automation; also a UI button action. target is an item GUID, container is an optional direct container GUID. Selects owned/nested inventory or a currently open external container; current contents revalidated. Never opens, scrolls, uses, moves, equips or loots. Button click returns ok/error; direct failure appears in snapshot.error. IDs must be positive unsigned 32-bit values.

fellowship.notes: create uses name; recruit, dismiss and leader use target GUID. Management checks current membership/leader authority; open fellowships allow member recruitment. Requests do not predict server state: observe fellowship.valid/name/open/leader/members before sequencing dependent actions.

say.notes: recipient sends a private tell (maximum 128 characters); otherwise channel=2048 sends fellowship chat, or local talk. Text is limited to 500 characters; no embedded newlines.

fields.title: single-line string; max 80 characters; empty uses manifest name
fields.controls: start_stop (default), toggle, or none; native lifecycle controls
fields.start_label: single-line string; max 40 characters; empty uses Start
fields.stop_label: single-line string; max 40 characters; empty uses Stop
fields.settings: boolean; show Settings and profiles section; default true
fields.status: boolean; show native status text; default true
fields.scroll: boolean; allow host panel scrolling; default true; false supplies panel width/height for pagination
fields.icon: PNG filename in plugin images/; max 96 characters; empty uses native emblem

window.opacity: number 0..1; background/frame only; foreground controls remain readable
window.pinned: boolean; hide outer frame and lock position; Quick-show temporarily restores controls
window.precedence: Player overrides take priority; force-global opacity overrides all plugin opacity requests

presentation.reset: Empty object restores manifest defaults; omitted output retains runtime overrides

fields.color: red/green/blue/yellow/white or #RRGGBB; implies color action when action omitted
fields.sender: optional exact sender; empty matches server output

chat_filters.matching: All supplied predicates must match; at least one text, sender or chat_type predicate is required; rules are ORed
chat_filters.lifetime: Omitted retains; empty array clears; stop/disable/reload/logout/character change clears
chat_filters.scope: Incoming display only; show bypasses per-window categories; hide wins conflicts; global filters and squelches apply; raw plugin chat_events and chat log files remain intact

chat_subscriptions.matching: chat_filters predicates; display actions/window/color do not affect delivery
chat_subscriptions.delivery: only matching messages enter a bounded per-plugin inbox; changing rules starts at newest; repeated registration preserves pending lines

sound.format: PCM16 WAV mono/stereo, 8..48 kHz, 10 seconds, 1 MiB

notice_style.window: 0/main, 1..4/extra, -1/all; explicit routing bypasses window category filters
notice_style.color: named color or #RRGGBB; retained with history

companion_identify.rate: one per second shared with commands
companion_identify.behavior: background appraisal, preserves selection and automation ownership

action_events.unknown: source/wcid apply to item use; spell applies to cast; serial/error apply to completion

action_history.scope: Completed use/cast history; available to selective readers; match identity, newer serial and request time. Cast confirmed is not projectile-hit confirmation.

inventory_failures.scope: Latest inventory failure only; match item and newer serial. Give success requires inventory evidence.

optional_cast_motion.jump_out_wand: cast_item only; 200 ms delay, discard after 750 ms
optional_cast_motion.cast_jiggle: eligible casts; backward with alternating strafe every 131 ms, bounded to 5 s
optional_cast_motion.cancellation: manual movement, blocked UI, stop, session change, completion or failure; ordinary collision applies

innate_spell.scope: inventory rows for assessed casting implements
innate_spell.eligibility: innate_spell_available checks known activation requirements, ownership, trade state and item mana; target eligibility is rechecked by cast_item

proc_debuff.scope: inventory rows for assessed physical weapons
proc_debuff.eligibility: proc_debuff_available checks activation, ownership/trade and mana; also require can_wield and ammunition. First appraised offensive timed non-War/non-Item spell only. Requires physical attacks and actual effect confirmation, never cast_item.

innate_recovery.scope: inventory rows for assessed casting implements
innate_recovery.eligibility: innate_recovery_available; check cooldowns; execute cast_item and verify vital change

route_doors.unknown: Locked/difficulty absent until successful appraisal; passage follows live physics

lockpick_available.meaning: Owned, unequipped, not offered in trade, remaining structure; retention allowed

item_icon.appearance: Unsigned 32-bit values; complete texture DIDs; same compositors as inventory/Supply Ledger
